import primitive_api as p
import json

def show(label, value):
    print(label, json.dumps(value, default=str))

show("world", p.observe_world())
show("inventory", p.list_inventory())
show("accessible", p.list_accessible_objects())
show("nearby", p.list_nearby_objects())
show("teleport_locations", p.list_teleport_locations())
show("action_schema", p.get_action_schema())
show("verification", p.check_success())

def act(name, **kwargs):
    validation = p.validate_action_call(name, kwargs)
    if not validation.get("ok", False):
        show("invalid_action", validation)
        return None
    result = getattr(p, name)(**kwargs)
    show(name, result)
    return result
